verbatim_quote.original: The Manager selects the winner afterward — do NOT implement, report only.
verbatim_quote.english_translation: The Manager selects the winner afterward — do NOT implement, report only.

extracted_decision.summary: Reserved winner selection for the Manager and prohibited implementation during the seven-seat brainstorm; the session was to report only.
extracted_decision.rationale: Keeps the brainstorm advisory and prevents unapproved changes before the Manager chooses between prompt variants.
alternatives: Allow the team or Architect to choose the winner immediately
Proceed to implementation during the brainstorm
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Creates a safer approval boundary and avoids rework, but delays implementation until Manager selection
